create_confusion_matrix_plot: create a confusion matrix plot from a fitted classifier using ConfusionMatrixDisplay.from_estimator with optional normalization
split_dataset_train_test: split a dataset into training and test sets using train_test_split with configurable test size and random state
build_svm_classifier: build a support vector machine classifier using svm.SVC with linear kernel and configurable regularization parameter C
load_iris_dataset: load the iris classification dataset using datasets.load_iris to get features, targets, and class names
compute_threshold_confusion_metrics: compute true negatives, false positives, false negatives, and true positives at multiple thresholds using confusion_matrix_at_thresholds
